title: andreassag/clystere pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for antiSMASH + GECCO + deepBGC biosynthetic gene cluster analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input and save output data.

input.description: Path to samplesheet CSV with columns: sample, genome[, annotation, fastq_1, fastq_2, assay_type].
input.help_text: CSV file with a header row. Required columns: `sample` (unique identifier) and `genome` (path to a GenBank/EMBL/FASTA file). Optional columns: `annotation` (GFF3 file), `fastq_1`, `fastq_2`, and `assay_type` (`metagenome` or `metatranscriptome`).

reads_input.description: Optional path to a reads samplesheet CSV with columns: sample, fastq_1[, fastq_2, assay_type] for BGC abundance/expression profiling.

outdir.description: Directory where pipeline results will be published.

clystere_db_dir.description: Directory where reference databases (antiSMASH, deepBGC, BiG-SLiCE, Bakta, CheckM2, GTDB-Tk) will be downloaded and cached.

preprocessing_dereplication_options.title: Genome preprocessing & dereplication
preprocessing_dereplication_options.description: Gene-calling options for unannotated FASTA inputs and optional genome dereplication before annotation.

annotation_tool.description: Gene-calling / annotation tool applied automatically to unannotated FASTA genomes.

pyrodigal_mode.description: Pyrodigal prediction mode (`single` for isolate genomes, `meta` for metagenomic contigs/MAGs).

bakta_db.description: Path to an existing Bakta database directory. Downloaded automatically when `--annotation_tool bakta` is selected and absent.

bakta_db_type.description: Bakta database variant to download automatically (`light` or `full`).

dereplicate_genomes.description: Dereplicate redundant input genomes/MAGs before BGC annotation.

dereplicate_tool.description: Tool used for genome dereplication when `--dereplicate_genomes` is enabled.

dereplicate_ani.description: ANI percentage threshold for dereplicating redundant genomes (e.g. `99.0` strain-level, `95.0` species-level).

qc_taxonomy_options.title: Assembly QC & taxonomy options
qc_taxonomy_options.description: Optional assembly contiguity QC (QUAST), MAG quality assessment (CheckM2), and taxonomic classification (GTDB-Tk).

quast_run.description: Run QUAST assembly contiguity metrics (N50, L50, contig counts).

checkm2_run.description: Run CheckM2 to estimate genome completeness and contamination.

checkm2_db.description: Path to a CheckM2 `.dmnd` database file or directory containing it. Downloaded automatically to `--clystere_db_dir` when absent.

checkm2_db_zenodo_id.description: Zenodo record ID used when automatically downloading the CheckM2 database.

gtdbtk_run.description: Run GTDB-Tk taxonomic classification and feed lineages into BiG-SLiCE and summary reports.

gtdbtk_db.description: Path to an extracted GTDB-Tk reference database directory (required when `--gtdbtk_run` is enabled unless `--gtdbtk_download_db` is true).

gtdbtk_download_db.description: Automatically download the GTDB-Tk reference package (~110 GB) if `--gtdbtk_db` is not supplied.

gtdbtk_db_url.description: Download URL for the GTDB-Tk reference database archive when `--gtdbtk_download_db` is enabled.

gtdbtk_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to `gtdbtk classify_wf`.

antismash_db.description: Path to an antiSMASH database directory. Downloaded automatically when absent or empty.

antismash_taxon.description: Taxonomic scope for antiSMASH detection rules.

antismash_minlength.description: Minimum sequence length (bp) for a record to be analysed.

antismash_limit.description: Maximum number of records to analyse per file. Set to -1 to disable.

antismash_minimal.description: Run antiSMASH in minimal mode. Individual modules can then be re-enabled selectively.

antismash_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the antiSMASH invocation.

antismash_modules_options.title: antiSMASH — analysis modules
antismash_modules_options.description: Enable or disable individual antiSMASH analysis modules. All are disabled by default when running in minimal mode.

antismash_fullhmmer.description: Run a full-genome Pfam HMM scan (`--fullhmmer`).

antismash_cassis.description: Run CASSIS cluster border prediction (`--cassis`). Requires a genome with gene annotation.

antismash_clusterhmmer.description: Run Pfam HMM scan limited to cluster regions (`--clusterhmmer`).

antismash_pfam2go.description: Map Pfam annotations to Gene Ontology terms (`--pfam2go`).

antismash_rre.description: Run RRE-Finder for RiPP recognition element detection (`--rre`).

antismash_smcog_trees.description: Generate phylogenetic trees for secondary metabolite COGs (`--smcog-trees`).

antismash_fullhmmer_pfamdb_version.description: Pfam database version to use with `--fullhmmer`.

antismash_clusterhmmer_pfamdb_version.description: Pfam database version to use with `--clusterhmmer`.

antismash_rre_minlength.description: Minimum amino acid length for RRE-Finder candidates.

antismash_tfbs_range.description: Upstream search range (bp) for TFBS detection.

antismash_tta_threshold.description: GC content threshold for TTA codon detection.

antismash_clusterblast_options.title: antiSMASH — cluster comparison
antismash_clusterblast_options.description: Options for cluster comparison and annotation modules (ClusterBlast, MIBiG).

antismash_cc_mibig.description: Compare clusters against the MIBiG reference database (`--cc-mibig`).

antismash_cc_custom_dbs.description: Comma-separated paths to custom ClusterCompare database config files (`--cc-custom-dbs`).

antismash_cb_knownclusters.description: Run KnownClusterBlast against MIBiG (`--cb-knownclusters`). Results are included in the tabulation summary when enabled.

antismash_cb_nclusters.description: Number of top ClusterBlast hits to report (default: 10).

antismash_cb_min_homology_scale.description: Minimum homology scale for ClusterBlast hits (0.0–1.0).

antismash_hmmdetection_options.title: antiSMASH — HMM detection
antismash_hmmdetection_options.description: Options controlling HMM-based BGC detection sensitivity.

antismash_hmmdetection_strictness.description: Strictness level for HMM-based rule detection.

antismash_hmmdetection_fungal_cutoff_mul.description: Multiplier applied to HMM cutoff scores for fungal genomes.

antismash_hmmdetection_fungal_neighbourh.description: Multiplier applied to neighbourhood size for fungal genomes.

antismash_hmmdetection_limit_to_rule_nam.description: Comma-separated list of rule names to restrict detection to.

antismash_hmmdetection_limit_to_rule_cat.description: Comma-separated list of rule categories to restrict detection to.

antismash_zip_output.description: Archive the antiSMASH output directory as a zip file.

antismash_summary_gbk.description: Write a summary GenBank file of all detected regions.

antismash_region_gbks.description: Write individual GenBank files for each detected region.

antismash_allow_long_headers.description: Allow header lines longer than 80 characters in output files.

antismash_sideload.description: Comma-separated paths to JSON sideload files (`--sideload`).

antismash_sideload_simple.description: Sideload a simple region by coordinates, e.g. `ACCESSION:START-END` (`--sideload-simple`).

antismash_sideload_by_cds.description: Comma-separated locus tags to sideload as a region (`--sideload-by-cds`).

gecco_run.description: Run GECCO alongside antiSMASH by default.

gecco_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the GECCO invocation.

deepbgc_run.description: Run deepBGC alongside antiSMASH by default.

deepbgc_data_dir.description: Path to deepBGC model/Pfam downloads. Downloaded automatically when absent.

deepbgc_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the deepBGC invocation.

expanded_discovery_options.title: Expanded BGC & peptide discovery
expanded_discovery_options.description: Optional SanntiS 4th BGC predictor, antimicrobial peptide (AMP) discovery (Macrel + AMPcombi), and RiPP/RRE preset.

sanntis_run.description: Run SanntiS as a 4th neural-network BGC predictor and integrate results into comBGC and clustering.

sanntis_interpro_dir.description: Optional directory of pre-computed per-sample InterProScan `.gff3`/`.tsv` files (matching `<sample_id>*`) passed to SanntiS via `--ip-file`.

sanntis_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to SanntiS.

amp_run.description: Run antimicrobial peptide (AMP) discovery using Macrel and AMPcombi.

amp_database.description: Reference AMP database used by AMPcombi (`DRAMP`, `APD`, or `UniRef100`).

amp_database_dir.description: Optional path to a local pre-downloaded AMPcombi reference database directory.

ripp_preset.description: Enable antiSMASH 8 RiPP & RRE-Finder modules (`--rre`, lanthipeptides, lassopeptides, sactipeptides, thiopeptides, `--asf`, `--clusterhmmer`) and extract `ripp_candidates.tsv`.

bigscape_options.title: BiG-SCAPE options
bigscape_options.description: Options for BiG-SCAPE gene cluster family (GCF) analysis.

bigscape_run.description: Run BiG-SCAPE on the unified comBGC-staged region set.

bigscape_pfam_path.description: Path to `Pfam-A.hmm`. Resolved automatically from `--antismash_db` when absent.

bigscape_dereplicate.description: Run `bigscape dereplicate` before `bigscape cluster` to remove near-identical BGCs.

bigscape_gcf_cutoffs.description: Space-separated list of GCF distance cutoffs passed to `--gcf-cutoffs`.

bigscape_mix.description: Analyse all BGC classes together in a single network (`--mix`).

bigscape_include_singletons.description: Include singleton BGCs (those that form no GCF) in the output (`--include-singletons`).

bigscape_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the BiG-SCAPE invocation.

bigscape_zip_output.description: Archive the BiG-SCAPE output directory as a `.tar.gz` file.

bigslice_options.title: BiG-SLiCE & BiG-FAM options
bigslice_options.description: Options for BiG-SLiCE GCF clustering and BiG-FAM database novelty querying.

bigslice_run.description: Run BiG-SLiCE on the unified comBGC-staged region set (can run independently or alongside `--bigscape_run`).

bigslice_db.description: Path to a BiG-SLiCE HMM database (`bigslice-models`) directory. Downloaded automatically when absent.

bigslice_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the BiG-SLiCE invocation.

bigfam_db.description: Path to a pre-computed BiG-FAM / BiG-SLiCE database directory to query via `bigslice --query` for BGC novelty scoring.

bigfam_n_ranks.description: Number of top GCF hits to return per BGC in BiG-SLiCE query mode.

bigfam_novelty_threshold.description: BiG-SLiCE distance (`d`-score) above which a queried BGC is flagged as putative novel.

bigfam_no_normalize.description: Pass `--no_normalize_feature` to `bigslice --query` (required for BiG-SLiCE v1.0.0 BiG-FAM databases with `--bigfam_novelty_threshold 900`; set `false` with threshold `~0.4` for BiG-SLiCE v2 DBs).

comparative_options.title: Comparative genomics & visualization
comparative_options.description: Gene-cluster synteny plotting (clinker) and gene-neighborhood homology searching (cblaster).

clinker_run.description: Generate interactive HTML synteny plots via clinker for every multi-member GCF from BiG-SCAPE and/or BiG-SLiCE.

clinker_max_bgcs.description: Maximum number of BGC members plotted per GCF by clinker.

clinker_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to clinker.

cblaster_run.description: Search representative/orphan BGC clusters for collocated homologues via cblaster.

cblaster_mode.description: cblaster search mode: `local` (offline cohort or `--cblaster_db` DIAMOND+SQLite DB) or `remote` (NCBI).

cblaster_db.description: Optional pre-built local cblaster `.dmnd` database path (paired with `.sqlite3`). When omitted in `local` mode, built from the cohort genomes.

cblaster_max_queries.description: Maximum number of representative/orphan query BGCs searched by cblaster.

cblaster_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to cblaster.

abundance_options.title: Metagenomic & metatranscriptomic abundance
abundance_options.description: Read-mapping options for quantifying BGC/GCF abundance (DNA) and expression (RNA) across cohorts.

abundance_mapper.description: Short/long-read aligner used to map reads against the non-redundant BGC catalog.

abundance_min_identity.description: Minimum read percent identity passed to CoverM contig quantification.

minimap2_extra_args.description: Additional arguments passed to `minimap2` when `--abundance_mapper minimap2` is selected.

tabulation_options.title: Tabulation & consensus summary options
tabulation_options.description: Options for antiSMASH tabulation and cross-tool consensus BGC summary generation.

run_tabulation.description: Generate per-region, per-genome, cross-tool consensus loci, and genome QC/BGC summary tables.

count_per_contig.description: Report BGC counts per contig rather than aggregated per genome assembly.

split_hybrids.description: Count each product type in hybrid BGCs separately. The `total_count` column is unaffected.

consensus_min_overlap.description: Minimum pairwise interval Jaccard overlap required to merge overlapping BGC calls across predictors.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Pipeline-level options that are not specific to any analysis step.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to `--outdir`.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: Use `copy` for portability. `symlink` saves disk space but breaks when the work directory is cleaned.

monochrome_logs.description: Disable ANSI colour codes in log output.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

version.description: Display the pipeline version and exit.
